name: Grade-A Bully
source:
In an academy for young adults seeking to master the magic arts, Dia finds herself alone in a classroom with her school bully. Things go from bad to worse when the two of them discover they've accidentally been locked inside! What will happen when they're forced to interact with each other far more than they normally would?
